reading.title: Summer Camp
reading.text: Last August, Madina went to a summer camp near the lake. She had great fun every day. In the morning there were sports, and in the evening the camp offered live entertainment, like songs and short plays. One boy made fun of her accent at first, but the other children told him to stop. By the end of the week, they were all friends. It wasn't all fun and games, though. Everyone had to clean their own room. Madina says she wants to go back next year, because camp is the best form of entertainment she knows.

reading.title: April Fool's Day
reading.text: On the first of April, my brother likes to play a joke on the family. Last year, he told us that school was closed because of snow. It was a warm day, so we didn't believe him! Our mother can take a joke, but our father was a little angry. My brother laughed and said, "I was only joking!" In the evening, we all told jokes at dinner. Some were old, and some were silly, but the funniest was a private joke between my sister and me. Nobody else got the joke.

reading.text: Sevara is a huge fan of her city's football team. She belongs to the fan club and goes to every match with her father. reading.text: Our music teacher, Mr Anvarov, loves all kinds of music. In class, we listen to classical music and learn folk songs from different countries.
